method: LLM full-note semantic coding with complete second-agent audit and documented reconciliation
provenance: The earlier Notes were authored by Claude Opus 5.5 high AI reviewer runs. The user confirmed subsequent human review of the copied workbook decisions. Those copied decisions determine selection and substantive status and are unchanged. The new semantic taxonomy and assignments are LLM-assisted content categories, not newly human-validated judgments or independent verification of trial errors.
audit_design: The second agent read all 139 full Notes and saved independent proposed categories, exact excerpts, and rationales before opening the v1 coding file. The agents shared the taxonomy and discussed boundary cases; the subsequent audit explicitly inspected v1 and reconciled differences. This is not a blinded interrater reliability study; no kappa or human-coder reliability statistic is claimed.
